_doc: Sounds and music by id (docs/protocolos/editar-a-mano.md). The file of an id is found by convention: assets/audio/<section>/<id>.ogg or .wav, or its variants <id>_01, <id>_02... (one is picked at random each time). No file yet = silence (and a note in debug). Sections: music, sfx, ambient, voice; each entry: bus (default Music / Sfx / Ambient / Voice by section; the buses are fixed in default_bus_layout.tres: Master, Music, Sfx, Ambient, Voice, Ui), volume_db, pitch_jitter (0-0.5: random pitch change per play, view only). phase_music: the music of each phase of the day. phase_ambient: the ambient loop of each phase in the town; interior_ambient: the ambient loop inside a building type (no entry = quiet inside). events: the sound of a sim event (only events of the player's family sound); a notice (notice_added) sounds by its key ("notice.objective_done") or else by its severity ("notice_added.warning", "notice_added.urgent"). Music and ambient files are imported with Loop on.
